last_result.summary: This iteration stayed focused on the saved build/verification blocker rather than new feature edits. Using a parallel review/debug pass, I verified that `npx --yes svelte-kit sync` completes cleanly and isolated the real failing step to `vite build`. A heartbeat-wrapped clean build now shows the prior missing preview artifacts were partly a false intermediate signal: the build successfully completes the SSR phase, enters the client build, and begins materializing `.svelte-kit/output/client`, but then the client/static-adapter portion is terminated with exit code `137` before finalizing `build/` and `manifest.js`. That means the earlier preview `[500] GET / TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'imports')` still points to an incomplete preview artifact set caused by the late build termination, not a confirmed route/runtime regression in the services browse code. No repository files needed to change in this iteration; the remaining work is still to get one uncontended clean build fully through the client/static adapter path, then rerun the targeted bootstrap and browser gates on the completed artifact set.
remaining_work: Run one uncontended clean `npm run build` to completion and confirm the final preview artifact contract exists together: `build/index.html`, `.svelte-kit/output/client`, `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest-full.js`, and `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js`.

If the clean build still terminates before finalizing the preview artifact set, continue tracing and reducing the late client-build/static-adapter memory pressure from the current lighter build baseline until the build completes deterministically.

Once the final artifact set is confirmed, rerun `CI=1 VITE_API_URL=https://api.example.test VITE_NOSTR_RELAY_URL=wss://relay.example.test VITE_E2E_TURNSTILE_BYPASS=true npm run test:e2e:validate-service-bootstrap` against that artifact set.

Rerun `CI=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/tasks-services-regression-browse.spec.ts --project=chromium --project='Mobile Safari' --workers=1 --retries=0 --reporter=line` against the clean built preview and confirm the Mobile Safari browse regression is resolved.
If the targeted browse rerun is green, rerun the remaining Mobile Safari non-visual aggregate and the final Chromium visual bundle to close the local `TEST-G3` / `TEST-G4` evidence.

Verify the remaining external `CI-G1` GitLab merge-policy requirements (`only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds`, required jobs active for merge requests) using `GITLAB_TOKEN`, `CI_API_V4_URL`, and `CI_PROJECT_ID` or the real GitLab CI environment.
